3d_player_controller.subject:
Let Godot expand the animation import blocks it was handed

The four .glb files that had no "animations" entry at all were given a
minimal one, enabled false with keep_custom_tracks true. Godot's own import
pass filled in the rest of the canonical form beside it, every slice_N
default included. Recording what the engine writes keeps the next import
from producing this same diff on every machine.

The settings that matter are unchanged: save_to_file is off for all 202
imports and keep_custom_tracks is true for all 29 hand-owned animations.
